scripts.build: ngc -p tsconfig.lib.json && ng-packagr -p ng-package.json -c tsconfig.packagr.json && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); const p='../../dist/grid-angular/package.json'; const pkg=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8')); const webPkg=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('../grid-web/package.json','utf8')); if(pkg.dependencies && pkg.dependencies['@tipolox/litgrid-web'] && pkg.dependencies['@tipolox/litgrid-web'].startsWith('workspace:')) { pkg.dependencies['@tipolox/litgrid-web'] = '^' + webPkg.version; } fs.writeFileSync(p, JSON.stringify(pkg, null, 2) + '\n'); fs.copyFileSync('../../LICENSE','../../dist/grid-angular/LICENSE');"
